# Binaries in rootfs/ systemd units that come from Arch Linux ARM packages, not
# from this repository. The ones under /usr/local/bin are checked directly by
# .github/workflows/checks.yml; these are the rest, listed so a typo in a unit's
# ExecStart shows up as a CI failure instead of a unit that quietly fails on the
# phone. Add a line here when a unit starts calling a new packaged program.
/usr/bin/chvt
/usr/bin/mmsdtng
/usr/bin/phosh-session
